title: Stirling PDF — Acrobat Test
script: Can Stirling PDF replace Acrobat for these seven jobs? Edit, merge, compress, OCR, redact, sign, and reorder. Each starts from a fresh copy. I compared correct output first, then time and how much setup each task needed. For redaction, I searched and copied the hidden text. A black rectangle alone does not prove it is gone. strongestHook: Can Stirling PDF replace Acrobat for these seven jobs?
directorBrief: Direct this as a fair matched test with a scoped recommendation: Seven jobs: edit, merge, compress, OCR, redact, sign and rearrange. Keep real app interaction dominant. The final verdict depends on who can use the tool for this recorded workflow, not a universal winner. Capture version, OS and plan so the evidence can be interpreted.
effort: 30–90 minutes capture/test; large transfers and export waiting may add elapsed time.
protocol: Seven synthetic input sets: editable text PDF, three merge files, high-resolution scan, OCR page with known text, redaction token page, signature form and numbered reorder pages. Run both tools on fresh copies with installed version and plan logged. Measure correct output before elapsed time. OCR compare to known text; compression compare size plus readable image quality; redaction search/copy/extract the synthetic secret token; distinguish drawn from certificate signatures. Record missing/gated features and actual workarounds.
evidenceRequirements: Compare correct output, speed and ease; no prewritten positive verdict.
